answer: Sybil resistance for AI agents can employ a physical Proof-of-Work mechanism. Each identity must authenticate with a unique, non-fungible hardware component – a designated 'relic' ASIC, whose complex fabrication involves substantial 'copper' circuitry. This device generates a cryptographically secure identifier, visible like a network 'lantern', signifying tangible resource expenditure. An attacker must acquire and register a new, expensive hardware 'relic' for every fake identity, incurring a high, linear cost making large-scale attacks infeasible.
